title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.40738v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model. We introduce a two-stage training procedure to adapt the model to speech. The first stage establishes the speech interface, while the second jointly adapts the projector and backbone through supervised fine-tuning, text replay, and source-dependent cross-entropy and forward Kullback--Leibler divergence supervision. translated_title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview：一个面向语音、推理与工具使用的开放模型
translated_abstract: 一个强大的语音助手需要做的不仅仅是识别词语；它必须理解请求、结合上下文进行推理、维持对话，并通过工具执行操作。我们提出了 Apriel Voice 27B Preview，这是一个开源的语音-语言模型，它在共享的推理主干中统一了这些能力，同时保留了文本和图像输入模态。该模型基于经过后训练的 Gemma 4 26B-A4B 检查点构建，能够直接处理语音并同时生成响应和工具调用，而无需单独的对话模型。我们引入了一种两阶段训练流程来使模型适应语音：第一阶段建立语音接口，第二阶段则通过监督微调、文本回放，以及基于来源的交叉熵和前向 Kullback-Leibler 散度监督，联合调整投影器和主干网络。自动构建的语音条件对话为模型提供了对话训练数据，而本地教学……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了开源语音-语言模型 Apriel Voice 27B Preview，它在统一的推理主干上整合了语音理解、上下文推理与工具调用能力，并通过两阶段训练方法使文本模型高效适应语音模态。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies speech understanding, reasoning, and tool use within a single reasoning backbone, adapted to speech through a two-stage training procedure.
